messages:
Tia Nguyen: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC change the EU staging edge started returning a bunch of 403s when fetching client certs from the keystore. Saw a spike ~09:12 UTC. KMS unwrap shows permission denied. Anyone on rotation/keystore team?

Samir Patel: I see similar in logs, looks like role:service-keystore-read removed in the change. Uploading excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:14Z keystore-service eu-west-1 unwrap: error=AccessDenied principal=svc/edge-proxy role=service-keystore-read
2026-03-22T09:12:15Z edge-proxy eu-west-1 handshake: client cert fetch failed status=403 path=/keystore/client/xyz
```

Leah Kim: @Samir can you paste the RBAC diff? we need to know what removed. Also check audit logs in audit-bucket for iam:Decrypt requests.

Samir Patel: Diff shows `service-keystore-reader` binding to `svc/old-deployer` was removed and a new binding for `svc/deployer-v2` was added, but the keystore policy only allows principals in `svc/*-keystore`. The deploy pipeline change on 2026-03-21 removed the old principal.

Leah Kim: OK. Short-term: rebind the old principal or add `svc/edge-proxy` to allowed principals. Recommend minimal blast radius: rebind in staging-eu first.

raj: Oncall — this is causing ~10% error rate on canary traffic, not prod yet but blocking smoke tests. @oncall-jane can you approve emergency rebind?

oncall-jane: I can approve. Quick checklist: 1) Verify audit trails for all Decrypt calls 2) Rebind minimal role 3) Monitor handshake success rate 4) Open a postmortem ticket.

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-1372
Runbook snippet: `rbac bind role=service-keystore-reader subject=svc/edge-proxy --env=staging-eu`

Tia Nguyen: following runbook now. Running bind command...
```
$ infractl rbac bind --role service-keystore-reader --subject svc/edge-proxy --env staging-eu
Applied role binding: service-keystore-reader -> svc/edge-proxy
```

Samir Patel: After the bind, keystore unwraps back to normal on my end. Handshake success for canaries improved from 89% -> 99.8% within 2m. We should still capture audit logs and create a follow-up to fix the deploy pipeline that removed the principal.

Leah Kim: Action items: (a) PR to deploy pipeline to avoid removing keystore principals; (b) Add alert: KMS:Decrypt denies > 3 in 5m in staging/eu; (c) Postmortem + label for compliance review.

Tia Nguyen: I'll open the postmortem and assign owners. Security question — do we need to rotate any certs or revoke anything due to the window? I only see failed unwraps, no successful extraneous unwraps.

raj: Checked audit snapshots — no successful Decrypts from unexpected principals during the interval. Rotation not required, but add a follow-up to verify end-to-end authz in KMS logs.

oncall-jane: Thanks team. Please update #INC-2026-1372 with chronology and link to RBAC PR. We'll schedule a short sync for the deploy pipeline fix.

ops-bot: Audit snapshot available: s3://redwood-audit/eu/2026-03-22/keystore-unwrap-403.json.gz

Tia Nguyen: Added chronology + links to the incident. Closing the immediate alert; keeping follow-ups open. :white_check_mark:
